jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 24d (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/scale.mjs, tools/scope-loop.mjs, tools/split-quality.mjs, tools/state-backup.mjs, tools/state-guard.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/main). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LEAVE: make NO change to that catch at all.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/scale.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/scale.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 148 `try { const st = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(...)); startedJobs = ...; } catch { /* not written yet */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT/SyntaxError (state.json not written yet, or mid-write), log the rest; no fallback value, `startedJobs` keeps its previous value and the poll loop retries.
- Line 165 `} finally { await api.close?.().catch(() => {}); }`: close/cleanup catch on a watch API connection that can't normally throw — LOG-ALWAYS with a different binding; no fallback value, best-effort close.

### tools/scope-loop.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/scope-loop.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 351 `const existing = await readReviewManifest(projectRoot, ticketFile).catch(() => null);`: SILENT-ENOENT (acceptance-review manifest not created yet), log the rest; keep null fallback (guarded by `if (existing && !existing.jobs?.length)`).
- Line 480 `try { summary = await summaryNow(); } catch { /* the ledger itself is the problem */ }`: building the final failure summary — LOG-ALWAYS (a lost diagnostic summary on the error path is as bad as a lost audit write), include the step/error context; keep `summary = null` fallback.

### tools/split-quality.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/split-quality.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 56 `} catch { /* damaged log lines do not invalidate the panel */ }`: SILENT-SyntaxError (one ticket-event log line is torn/corrupt), log the rest; no fallback value, that one event line is skipped.
- Line 66 `readLedger(root).catch(() => null),`: SILENT-ENOENT (a corrupt ledger must be visible, so SyntaxError is logged) (no ledger yet, or torn write), log the rest; keep null fallback (one entry of the `Promise.all` array).

### tools/state-backup.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/state-backup.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 125 `try { await readManifest(root, id); complete.push(id); } catch { /* incomplete: left alone */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT/SyntaxError (backup manifest missing or torn mid-write), log the rest; no fallback value, the incomplete backup id is just left out of `complete`.
- Line 177 `} catch { // unreadable or incomplete backup: skipped }`: SILENT-ENOENT/SyntaxError (same, when listing backups), log the rest; no fallback value, the backup entry is omitted from `out`.

### tools/state-guard.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/state-guard.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 165 `await handle.chmod(0o600).catch(() => {});`: part of writing a security-relevant audit record — LOG-ALWAYS, include the deletions.log path; no fallback value, write proceeds regardless.
- Line 170 `} catch { /* never throws */ }`: lost audit write (the whole deletions.log append is swallowed if it throws) — LOG-ALWAYS, include the caller/outcome context; no fallback value, `recordDeletion` just returns.

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
